Question
========
Which of the following is an example of data definitions in a DMP?

Answerlist
----------
* Specifying file formats and types of collected data
* Advertising research results
* Listing personal information of all participants
* Writing software manuals for the project


Solution
========
Data definitions include specifying file formats and types of collected data.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
